high_level_description: A single golden retriever dog running dynamically across a wide 1600x900 landscape, with prominent floppy ears and rich golden coat, set against a pale sky and simple green grass ground.

compositional_deconstruction.background: pale sky (#E0F7FA) occupies top 750px; grass (#4CAF50) is a horizontal band from y=750 to y=900

elements.desc: golden retriever body: large oval torso in golden yellow, centered horizontally
left floppy ear: wide downward-curving ellipse, golden yellow, attached top-left of head
right floppy ear: wide downward-curving ellipse, golden yellow, attached top-right of head
head: rounded rectangle, golden yellow, overlapping top of torso
front left leg: vertical rectangle angled slightly forward, golden yellow
front right leg: vertical rectangle angled slightly forward, golden yellow
hind left leg: vertical rectangle angled backward, golden yellow
hind right leg: vertical rectangle angled backward, golden yellow
tail: short curved rectangle arching upward from rear, golden yellow
